source_refs.note: Basic Properties of Amides: a main subheading of 24.5 Amides, its own page (owner 2026-11-04); PDF 127-127.

blocks.text: Amides aliphatic amines se kam basic hain. Amines ke ulat, amides paani mein neutral solution banate hain. In mein resonance hoti hai: nitrogen ka lone pair carbonyl group ke oxygen ki taraf phail (delocalise ho) jata hai. Is se nitrogen par electrons kam milte hain aur basicity kam ho jati hai.

blocks.alt: R-C(=O)-NH2 jis ke N par lone pair aur do curly arrows hain (C=O ke electrons O par; N ka lone pair C-N bond mein), double-headed resonance arrow, aur R-C(-O-)=NH2+.
blocks.caption: Amide mein resonance (kitab ke page 128 par chhape diagram ke mutabiq hamari apni drawing).

blocks.title: Diagram ko samjhein
blocks.text: Pehle structure mein C=O ke electrons oxygen par jate hain aur nitrogen ka lone pair C–N bond mein aa jata hai. Doosre structure mein oxygen negative aur nitrogen positive hai aur C=N double bond hai. Asal amide in dono ke beech hai, is liye nitrogen ka lone pair kam milta hai (amide weak base hai) aur C–N bond aam single bond se chhota hai.
Carbon aur nitrogen ke beech double bond character (double bond jaisi khoobi) aa jane se amide ka C–N bond (132 pm) aam C–N single bond (147 pm) se chhota ho jata hai.

blocks.alt: R-C(=O)-NH2 ke C-N bond ki taraf arrow, label (132 pm); aur R-CH2-NH2 ke C-N bond ki taraf arrow, label (147 pm).
blocks.caption: Amide aur amine mein C-N bond length (lambai) (kitab ke page 128 par chhape diagram ke mutabiq hamari apni drawing).
